text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I could've sworn someone called my 
name just now...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ah. Could it be that someone was hungry?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, I'm making chanko nabe! Come on 
out, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Goddesses. Hehe, if you'd like, would 
you three care to join me for some chanko 
nabe—
